method.control: same stream and payloads without producer headers
method.producer: one distinct 68-byte gateway-shaped producer ID at sequence zero per append

summary.rss_interpretation: Inconclusive: mimalloc returned large regions during sampling, and one producer-minus-control delta was negative. Raw samples are retained; no per-producer heap estimate is claimed from RSS.
summary.physical_snapshot_interpretation: Cumulative local files are retained without pruning, so logical snapshot body bytes are the authoritative per-build comparison.
summary.restart_effect: Each distinct gateway boot producer ID creates one retained producer entry; the producer workload uses gateway-shaped IDs to model this cardinality.
